title: Not powerful enough, slow, designed badly- not a good product
text:
Not powerful enough, slow, designed badly- not a good product. I bought one of these due to my 18 year old VitaMix unit needing a part that would cost more than this system. I found it for a price more than 1/2 off Amazon's price at a brick and mortar store so I took the plunge.

PROS: It is an elegant looking system with the chrome front on the motor unit. I like having 16 oz. individual smoothie cups that the blade unit attaches to for making single serving smoothies. Cleanup is easy if there are no 'complications' (see CONS).

CONS: This thing simply isn't strong enough to really make a decent smoothie in a short time (350 watts motor). If you are using the 16 oz. cups I would advise only putting about 12 oz. in it or it will bog down. The motor will shut off if it gets to be too much (all the blue lights will flash... after this happens 3-4 times you will have to wait 3-5 minutes before you can use the unit again- who has time for that?!). And most of that better be liquid- this thing cannot handle a lot of ice, fruit or veggies. If you decide to fill one of the cups be prepared to 'steady' the cup as the smoothie is being made while the motor shuts down repeatedly. If you don't 'steady' the cup it will wobble and cause the motor to shut down even quicker- terrible design flaw!

The 32 oz. cup needs the same advise- don't fill it up or you will be making smoothies for about 15 minutes! Pulsing the ingredients in a full container (whether it be the 32 oz. or 16 oz.) before you go full bore at making a smoothie in either container helps but not a lot.

The design of this unit is so poor that any leakage coming out of the 32 oz. container will go right into the motor unit. There is a drain hole in the motor unit to allow for such occurrences yet maybe Cuisinart should design the unit so nothing goes into the motor unit. It would appear that having liquids in that area is not a good thing. It is nearly impossible to get out any liquids that leak into the spinning area of the motor unit.

I have not used the dry items cutting cup... I don't think it will be much better.

BOTTOM LINE: I will use this unit until I get my part for my VitaMix unit. Once I get that part I will only use this for mixing powdered drinks- I cannot see this thing lasting very long making smoothies on a daily basis. Maybe I am spoiled by my VitaMix being able to handle anything thrown at it without shutting down or bogging down. After owning a VitaMix for 18 years (and replacing 3 parts over that time) I would say if you are serious about making great smoothies please spend the money on something similar to the VitaMix and avoid this Cuisinart.

description: Meet the Cuisinart SmartPower Compact Portable Blending/Chopping System the slim and trim powerhouse that does it all! Use the streamlined blender jar to make smoothies in a flash! Mince herbs in the chopping cup and whip up custom drinks right in the travel cups weve included four of them so everyone can have their favorite!

Designed to fit anywhere, the Compact Portable Blending/ Chopping System delivers big-blender performance, with a 350-watt motor and the ease of single-hand operation with the user-friendly electronic touchpad! Stainless steel accents create an attractive, fashionable addition to any kitchen. New BPA free Tritan from Eastman co-polyestor is used for the all vessels blender jar, chopping cup and your travel cups. They are all shatter resistant and dishwasher safe. A real timesaver, cleanup and maintenance become simple chores.
Product Parts and Benefits
32-oz. BPA-free easy-grip blending jar
with cover and pour lid has a unique, sturdy design for all your blending needs. Lid fits on top with a 1-oz. measured pour lid.
8-oz BPA-free chopping cup
with lid handles a variety of food preparation tasks including chopping, grinding and whipping.
Four 16-oz BPA-free travel cups with lids
allow you to blend for one. Make your favorite drinks: smoothies, protein, health and diet drinks and more!
Two high-quality blade assemblies
are strong enough for all blending, chopping and grinding tasks. They are self-aligning so that the cups easily fit on the base. Blade assemblies are interchangeable for desired tasks.
Heavy-duty motor base with stainless steel accent
is sturdy and stable, housing a compact 350-watt motor with a safety interlock feature.
3-function touchpad control with LED indicator lights
is easy to use, read and clean. The blue LED lights clearly indicate what speed you are using.
Slip-proof feet
prevent movement during use and prevent damaging marks on countertops or tables.
Cord storage
keeps countertops safe and neat by conveniently storing excess cord.
Product Features

Sleek electronic touchpad with LED indicator lights Powerful 350-watt motor High, Low and Pulse controls Standby mode; safety interlock and auto stop features BS housing with stainless steel front pane BPA-free Tritan 32-oz. blender jar, 8-oz. chopping cup, and set of four 16-oz. travel cups Patented ultra-sharp stainless steel blades Two interchangeable blade assemblies: blending blade and chopping blade Recipe Book Dishwasher safe Limited 3-year warranty
Easy to Clean

To clean, squirt a small amount of dishwashing liquid into blender jar or cups and fill halfway with warm water. Attach blade assembly. Run on Low for 15 seconds. Repeat, using clean tap water. Carefully disassemble parts and empty blender jar or cups. Rinse and dry all parts thoroughly. Finally, wipe the motor base clean with a damp cloth to remove any residue, and dry thoroughly.
